claims: Val Kilmer died in Los Angeles.
Val Kilmer had been battling throat cancer since 2014.
Val Kilmer's throat cancer necessitated a tracheostomy.
Val Kilmer's family confirmed his death.
Val Kilmer's family noted he passed away surrounded by loved ones.
Val Kilmer had a cancer diagnosis in 2014.
Val Kilmer suffered from long-term health issues after his 2014 cancer diagnosis.
Val Kilmer's long-term health issues included the loss of his voice.
Val Kilmer continued to work after his 2014 cancer diagnosis.
Following Val Kilmer's death, Val Kilmer’s family authorized the use of AI to replicate his voice and likeness for a new film, "As Deep as the Grave".
The film "As Deep as the Grave" was announced in 2026.
Tom Cruise was Val Kilmer's Top Gun co-star.
Tom Cruise publicly honored Val Kilmer at CinemaCon shortly after his passing.
Val Kilmer was known for his roles in Top Gun, Batman Forever, Tombstone, and The Doors.
